unverified_points: Full XLSX/OPC/schema correctness is not claimed; cell payload/sharedStrings/styles/defined names keep existing boundaries.
No safe SQLite/answer/package build/UI/model/full class setup tested in this subtask.
A fallback rejects chartsheet/non-worksheet bindings rather than guessing another member.
URI resolver is a supported whole-part subset, not all OPC/IRI percent/case/Unicode equivalence or query/fragment semantics.

Binding/sheetData empty-sink contract does not claim direct Reader rollback for unrelated later cell/style/media errors.
